text: Ɓen suuɗooɓe kon ko Men Jippini immorde e ɓaŋngannduyee tinndinɗo goona Annabiijo on e kon ko o addi, jeyaaɓe e Alyahuuda e Annasaara, ɓaawo nde Men Feññinani ɗum yimɓe ɓen ka defte maɓɓe; ɓen ɗon [suuɗooɓe], Allah Woɗɗintinay-ɓe e Yurmeende Makko, Malaa'ika en e Annabi en e yimɓe ɓen fof kadi huɗirayɓe woɗɗintineede e Yumeende Allah.
